information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5929f8a41a183746e6dfaa7436280533243ae518/logo_cropped_no_date.png) ## This is the specialist Big Blind & Multi-Blind competition of [Kewbz UK Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026) #### As 4BLD, 5BLD and MultiBlind are not being held at [Kewbz UK Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the UK's Champion for each of these events! The podium finishers will be crowned during the awards ceremony in Birmingham, 2 weeks after this competition * *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK National Champion of these events.* If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Spectators may attend for free, however this competition does not feature any traditional speedcubing events and is not recommended for newcomers.**
